text: Before the Emperor faced Horus, one son reached him first.
Sanguinius, the Angel, Primarch of the Blood Angels.
asr: Sanguineus, the angel, Primark of the Blood Angels.

text: He had foreseen his own death, and went anyway.
Aboard Horus's flagship, the two brothers met.
asr: aboard Horace's flagship the two brothers met

text: Horus offered him a place at his side.
asr: Horace offered him a place at his side.

text: Horus broke him, and cast him down.
asr: Horace broke him and cast him down.

text: But the Angel had struck true, and left a crack in Horus's armour.
asr: But the angel had struck true, and left a crack in Horace's armour.

text: Through it, the Emperor would end the Heresy.
His sons still carry his death in their blood.
